caseNameFull: Pino v. Nicolls, District Director, Immigration and Naturalization Service
attorneys: Jacob Spiegel for petitioner., Solicitor General Sobeloff for respondent.

opinions.text:
The application for bail, referred to the Court by Mr. Justice Frankfurter, is dismissed for the reason that the question is *973moot, petitioner having been admitted to bail.

Jacob Spiegel for petitioner. Solicitor General Sobeloff for respondent.
